item.text: The hook already produces a country value internally; its tuple return and two loading checks are the main consumer changes. PhoneInput currently defaults to `'US'`, so I’m checking its existing tests and state transitions before changing how it adopts a later default.

The hook consumers now read a single country value. PhoneInput starts with no country when the default is empty, then adopts the first eligible country and keeps it for that mount. I’ve added regression checks for those transitions and will run the existing component tests.
